William; German-British astronomer; discovered Mimas and Enceladus (1738-1822).
Shook by a Titan in the war between Titans and Olympians.
Mountain piled up with Mt. Ossa in war with gods.
Mt. Pelion piled on top of it in war between Titans and Gods.
King of the Round Table Assemblage.
Companion of Arthur's; he was tricked into jousting with Arthur.
Arthur's half sister; enchantress; plotted to destroy Arthur but failed.
Queen; wife of Arthur; lover of Launcelot.
King of Lyoness; marries King Mark's sister, who dies bearing their son, Sir Tristram.
Wife of Uther; mother of Arthur.
King of Benwick; father of Sir Launcelot, ally of Arthur in the battle of Bedgrayne.
Magician and prophet; son of the devil; Arthur's mentor.
King whose duty was to pursue the questing beast and either run it to earth or lose his strength.
A knight of the Round Table.
King of Gaul; father of Sir Ector de Marys, Sir Bors, Sir Lyonel.
Bastard son of Launcelot and Elaine. He went on the quest to find the Holy Grail.
Delivers poison wound to Tristram before being mortally wounded by him.
Ruler of all Britain; Arthur's father.
King Arthur's favorite; champion and lover of Queen Gwynevere.
Eldest son of King Lot; Arthur's favorite cousin.
Arthur's bastard son and mortal enemy; delivered fatal wound to Arthur but was killed by him.
Older son of King Lot; killed by Sir Launcelot in his rescue of Gwynevere from burning.
Youngest son of King Lot; killed by Sir Launcelot in his rescue of Gwynevere from burning.
King of the West, principal enemy of Arthur.
King of the West, principal enemy of Arthur.
Leader of the rebel kings of the north and west. Married Margawse and begat Sir Gawain, Sir Aggravayne, Sir Gaheris.
Daughter of King Pelles, lover of Sir Launcelot and mother, by him, of Sir Galahad.
Very pure knight; accomplished quest of Holy Grail.
Pellinore's son; sent testing horn to King Mark to expose adultery of Sir Tristram.
Saved Iseult; fell in love with her.
